name: DearTimeline
author: ankit07721

sections.description: DearTimeline allows you to create beautiful, responsive vertical timelines with ease.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/deartimeline directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the [deartimeline] shortcode in any page or post.
    • Example with animation: [deartimeline animation="flip-up"]
    • Options: fade-in (default), flip-up, zoom
sections.faq:
How do I use the shortcode?

Simply add [deartimeline] to any page or post.

Can I change the layout?

Yes, you can use parameters like [deartimeline layout="classic"] or [deartimeline layout="flat"].
